name: Party System
description: Creates a small player party, tracks members, and emits shared-credit events that eligible quest/progression systems can consume. The members are the request's to name: `members` lists them in march order, the leader first, and a host that names none keeps its own bench. Naming them is what lets the party's names and the board's units agree — a formation that drives a member nobody placed drives nobody.

implementations.note: Implemented in the consuming application; not verifiable from this repository.

inputs.name: members
inputs.description: Named members in march order, the leader first, up to maxMembers; a name the party announces as it joins. Empty keeps the host's default bench, drawn at random, which is how a party with no request gets a fixed group per seed.
